def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

                mask=tuple(tuple(1 if (y,x) in cells else 0 for x in range(c0,c1+1)) for y in range(r0,r1+1))

    # frames: open (0) regions in left interior; but easier: fill each 0-cell connected to hole color with matching shape

    seen2=set()
    for i in range(h):

def components(grid, color=None):
    """List of 4-connected components of cells (optionally of one color), each with its cells, color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if (color is None or grid[i][j] == color) and grid[i][j] != 0 and (i, j) not in seen:
                c = grid[i][j]
                q = [(i, j)]; seen.add((i, j)); cells = []
                while q:
                    y, x = q.pop(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == c and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                comps.append((c, cells))
    return comps

def bbox_mask(cells):
    """Normalized binary mask of a set of cells within its bounding box."""
    ys = [c[0] for c in cells]; xs = [c[1] for c in cells]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
    s = set(cells)
    return tuple(tuple(1 if (y, x) in s else 0 for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1))

def split_sides(grid):
    """Split a grid at an all-zero separator column into (left, right) halves."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zc = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i in range(h))]
    s = next(j for j in zc if any(grid[i][k] != 0 for i in range(h) for k in range(j + 1, w)))
    e = next(j for j in range(s, w) if any(grid[i][j] != 0 for i in range(h)))
    return [row[:s] for row in grid], [row[e:] for row in grid]
'''
